profile.headline: Java Full Stack Developer at Fiserv
profile.summary:
- Around 15 years of professional experience as a Java Full Stack developer implementing high performance, low-latency, scalable, multithreaded and concurrent web applications. 

- Skilled in financial transactional, billing and reporting experience in Banking, Telecom, Maritime and Airline industry domain projects.

- Skilled in BackEnd technologies like Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST Apis, Microservices, Kafka, C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, C++, Network and System Programming.

- Skilled in FrontEnd technologies Angular, React, Html, Javascript, Typescript, Bootstrap.

- Skilled in various cloud platforms like AWS, Azure and GCP involving AWS EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, ECS, EKS services using infrastructure as code tools like Terraform.

- Expertise in technology prototyping and building proof of concepts from white board theories. Self-driven, detail oriented, decisive and a quick learner.

positions.description:
Employer: Western Outdoor Interactive

- Implemented report engine and achieved local and cloud data pipelines with micro-services architecture. It is using various backend and frontend technogolies like Java, Spring, Spring Boot, C#, .Net Core, Web Apis, Rest Apis, AWS, Azure for data pipeline staging and longer data retention.

- It is using C++ based customized enterprise router at network layer L2, L3 andL4. It integrates in-built wifi portal redirection, radius authorization-accounting. It has different tier plans implementation for Maritime and Airline industries.

projects.title: Kepler - Web based Office Simulation
projects.description: Kepler is an extremely powerful simulation technology. It simulates the entire Application interface on the learner’s machine. All menus, toolbars, dialog boxes, task panes appear and behave as they do in the actual application making the entire experience so effective and real that the learner perceives as if he or she is working inside the actual application. Skill retention is much higher because learners learn by actually doing tasks. 100% web based, the learning objects are so light that tutorials and assessments launch almost instantaneously even on a 56K dialup connection.
